messages:
jess: noticed a spike in customer-facing timeouts and 5xxs starting ~09:12 UTC, a few high-sev tickets. tracing shows gateway returning 504s for /v1/generate. examples in ticket 8492 and 8497. can we triage?

ops-bot: alert: hosted-inference-gateway:504 x6 in 1m (region: us-west-2)

samir: on it. can folks paste a request id or a sample curl? need correlation-id to pull backend logs.

maria: adding logs from a customer repro: `correlation_id=cb87f9a2` stack snippet: `upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream` plus `conn_reset_by_peer` in the same window.

jess: repro curl we used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-4b","input":"hello"}' -v``` got `HTTP/1.1 504` consistently when payloads had streaming=true and content-length ~0.

samir: quick checks: 1) confirming autoscaler didn't spin up extra inference pods (scaling metrics flat) 2) edge proxy logs show 502->504 transitions. suspect connection queueing causing idle upstream timeouts.

ryan: i'm seeing an odd spike in TLS handshake time in the proxy (~200ms->1.2s) right before the 504s. looks like a brief backend connection churn. could be new kernel tuning from last night's infra change.

maria: also saw auth refresh rate errors around same window: `401 token validation failed: upstream timeout` weird ordering. support-bot has the customer tickets: #8492 customer says retrying helped for ~10m then errors resumed.

samir: mitigation idea: 1) temporarily increase upstream read timeout from 30s->60s on the gateway (safe short-term) 2) revert the kernel TCP backlog change pushed 02:00 UTC 3) enable a canary of connection-reuse tweaks on a subset of proxies. any objections?

jess: +1 for increasing timeout and reverting kernel tweak. do we have a quick rollback playbook?

ryan: rollback steps in infra runbook: `infra/ops/rollbacks/kernel-tuning.md` — i'll coordinate, need a 10-min maintenance window to avoid customer noise. scheduling now.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window 09:45-09:55 UTC: revert kernel tcp_backlog change on proxy fleet subset.

maria: implementing gateway timeout bump now (config push to edge-config-prod), will watch traces and error rate.

support-bot: updated tickets 8492/8497: informed customers we're investigating and applying temporary mitigation, ETA ~15m.

jess: after timeout bump and kernel revert, error rate dropped ~85% within 6m. some customers still report intermittent 502s but overall is stable.

samir: next actions (post-incident): - root cause analysis on connection churn + auth validator timeouts - add an automated metric alert for TLS handshake latency > 500ms - add an integration test simulating streaming=true payloads with many small connections to catch regressions - evaluate if upstream read timeout should be adaptive based on queue length

ryan: logging follow-up: correlate conn resets with instance restarts in the same timeframe, and add a short-lived histogram for backend socket connect latency. I'll own the observability tickets.

maria: i'm owning the customer comms follow-up + ticket resolution list, will send template notes for SRE to include in closure.

jess: +1. let's capture everything in a brief incident follow-up doc and pick owners for the action items. thanks all for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
